origin: board centre, PCB top surface at z = 0, +Y towards the USB edge

layers.name: base
layers.purpose: Bottom. Hex pockets hold the M3 nuts; the two small holes reach the module's BOOT and RESET buttons.

layers.name: bottom-frame
layers.purpose: Ring around the underside parts, open at the top edge for the MCU module and its USB-C socket. Frosted acrylic spreads the underglow.

layers.name: top-frame
layers.purpose: Spacer between PCB and plate; sets the switch height.

layers.name: plate
layers.purpose: Switch plate, a 1.6 mm FR4 board the switches clip into. A 0.5 mm M3 washer on each screw sets its height.
